rationale: The metrics show emailservice experiencing extreme anomalies with a +6238% CPU spike, massive disk I/O increase, and >360% latency growth, while all other services remain stable. This localized resource exhaustion aligns with the retrieved CPU throttling runbook and explains the upstream latency/availability alert.

proposed_fix.description: Scale up emailservice replicas or increase CPU/memory limits to resolve the resource exhaustion and clear the latency backlog.
